exposure: Giving birth during the early COVID-19 pandemic
outcome: Serious morbidity from common obstetric complications (hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, postpartum hemorrhage, infections other than SARS-CoV-2)
cohort: Individuals who gave birth on randomly selected dates in 2019 (before the pandemic) and 2020 (during the pandemic) at 17 U.S. hospitals.
finding: Giving birth during the early COVID-19 pandemic was not associated with higher rates of serious maternal morbidity from common obstetric complications.
